DefaultDialogue: Be careful when traveling outside the city. An invasionary force gathers out there!
New Corsica is in desperate need of able-bodied heroes.
Your courage has given New Corsica a chance to resist Crassus. The people thank you!
They said this was a land of miracles. I had begun to believe it was simply a land of nightmares.
You are not familiar to me. And I do not know a Tribune Kraus. Where is everyone? What happened to the fort?
You are not familiar to me. And I do not know a Tribune Kraus. Where is everyone? What happened to the fort?
So much has changed. How could I have been dreaming for so long? I must gather my wits about me…
Prefect Drusilla commands these soldiers. She’s a bloodthirsty warmonger who serves only her own ambition.
Drusilla has a bodyguard named Magnus. He’s a giant of a Gaul who could kill most men with his bare hands.
The success of your raids has left the camp in disarray! Drusilla will seek to close ranks with her tribunes. She’s always so predictable.
Drusilla must feel as if she’s stalked by Nemesis herself. I wouldn’t be surprised if the invasion of New Corsica was entirely her design.
I humbly beg your pardon. This letter… comes as a terrible shock…
The defense of New Corsica continues. Steel yourself for the coming conflict.
There you are, friend! I’ve spoken to Prefect Severan. He’s recalling the remaining Praetorians and securing the city.
There are many evils that plague this land. Soon there will have to be a reckoning.
I wanted to believe that the noble man who sacrificed so much, the loyal soul who loved friends and family, the champion who diligently protected the people of New Corsica, still existed.
Hail, hero of New Corsica! Your deeds shall endure as long as the stars!
Hail, Hero of New Corsica! Always good to see you.
I still can’t believe Queen Cleopatra’s alive. The city rejoices at her return!
There is no doubt in my mind, you were sent by the gods. You are a hero out of myth.
Welcome to New Corsica, stranger. I apologize for the state of our city but we live in troubled times.
Welcome to New Corsica, stranger. I apologize for the state of our city but we live in troubled times.
Word of your remarkable deeds is spreading, noble warrior. New Corsica salutes you!
This is the dawning of a new day for our city and our people.
The gods prepare to return, stranger! They judge our every deed, word, and thought!
New Corsica has lost its way! We have displeased the gods and now evil sweeps over these lands led by a terrible demon!
If we do not prove ourselves worthy, the gods will never return! We must prepare the way! An age of enlightenment awaits us!
What will become of us? Repent before it is too late! I pray the gods have mercy upon us all!
Be warned, New Corsica! The tyrant’s son has returned! We must be vigilant! There is a venomous serpent in our midst!
I must prepare the way… I do this for you, my beloved… enlightenment will come to the people…
Greetings, pilgrim. The gods once inhabited this holy site. Tread with reverence for they are watching.
The idols here were once vessels for the gods. The Pontifex believes that with the proper holy relic, we may call upon their power to aid us in our time of need.
The relic’s dimensions must be precise. A hand in length, a palm in breadth, two digits in height… Yes, that’s correct!
There! The holy relic is done. It’s far more beautiful than I imagined. I put the hope of New Corsica in your hands, noble hero.
I have failed the people of New Corsica and exposed you to terrible danger. Please forgive my unworthiness.
Please allow me time for quiet reflection. I must pray for forgiveness and seek to atone for my failure.
One thing has become clear to me: The Pontifex has lost her reason. The long centuries have proven too much for her mind. For her, immortality proved to be a curse.
Oh goodness, it seems the Pontifex once loved Crassus. She calls him by his first name, Lucius. She’s even written romantic poetry about him…
According to the Codex, the Prime Key can be reassembled in something called the Forge of Ptah.
With the Prime Key, I believe we now have hope of stopping Crassus and preventing another curse from being unleashed upon the land.
There you are! I’ve finished translating the glyphs in the Forge of Ptah. I know the purpose of the Prime Key.
The gods of this land bless you, noble hero. You are truly their chosen champion.
I am filled with joy! I never thought I’d live to see such a wondrous event. And it’s all thanks to you, my non-believer.
How is an honest, hardworking merchant to make a living under these wretched conditions?
Look at this wreckage! It’s a disgrace! Where are the blasted Praetorians?
Well, I still insist that monster was a manticore! And you singlehandedly destroyed it!
I am here on official Marauder business. I have no time to trifle with you. Why don't you come back when you've got some guts!
Well met, fellow Marauder! What trophies have you taken lately?
Pah, you're in the wrong place. Go beg the gods for help, or whatever it is you do.
Walk back the way you came. Unless you're looking for a good fight…
Ah, the sight of you warms this old warrior's heart. Keep winning glory, for mighty Mars and the Marauders!
Begone! I have time only for those who crave knowledge. The Syndicate keeps to our own.
Ah, excuse me, I was lost in thought. How might the Syndicate serve you?
Spare me your misguided idealism. My time is too valuable to waste with you.
You're looking for Commander Maximo, Marauder. My words would be meaningless to you.
Ah, excuse me, I was lost in thought. How might the Syndicate serve you?
Hmm… Those who are truly blind cannot see even in the light.
If you always give, you will always have. What may I give you, devotee?
Those who live by the sword will perish by it. Be on your way, Marauder.
Are you here to make amends for your hubris? Let me know if you change your mind.
You are a beacon of hope and life in these trying times. Every deed, from the humble to the great, kindles the light in all of us.
The Legion's at our door, and the Ancients are rampaging across the sands. Let us drink and laugh while we can!
PLACEHOLDER
Hearken to me, traveler! These roads are dangerous. Be on your guard!
Praise the gods! I’ve been desperate to send word to New Corsica.
Malatesta joined the Praetorians a few years ago. There were some problems at first and he almost mustered out.
Prefect Severan must be informed of the situation here. The roads are more perilous than ever. I wish I had better news.
The defense of our roads will continue. Oh, should you encounter any Corrupted or Lost on the roads, I’d appreciate you eliminating the threat.
You have entered a desperate battlefield, stranger! Be ready to defend yourself against the Corrupted!
Crassus has split his legion. He has taken the First Cohort to assault Akhet.
Your courage and skill are inspiring, but the sight of those siege engines darkens my hopes.
Well done, noble hero! This Hydra’s Breath will burn those blasted siege weapons to the ground!
You must find the noble Evandrus Crassus! He may prove a great ally to our cause!
Your deeds will never be forgotten! New Corsica would be fortunate to have you as a citizen!
This place holds many dangers for the unwary. Make sure your weapon is at the ready, and keep your wits about you.
There is never enough wine around when you need it. I am simply parched and could do with a cold drink.
Greetings, Seeker. I'm tracking the movements of the 19th Legion. My task, I fear, will never be finished.
My farm was all but destroyed the last time I needed to travel to New Corsica.
I hope you have paid your taxes recently! If you have, you needn't worry about a visit from me, Caeso, Frumen of New Corsica!
Welcome to the Thermae, my friend - the finest place to rest in all of Brimstone Sands!
Thank you for the delivery… and your discretion. For you, the baths are complimentary!

<g id="g_female_takeandgiveitem5s" priority="high" />These items are fine specimens. You have an eye for this sort of work, youngster.
Apophis is a Primordial, one of the powerful elders of the Angry Earth. I had believed him banished long ago.
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands"  bin="2" bout="2"/>Apophis is a Primordial, an elder of the Angry Earth we believed banished. His return heralds the destruction of humanity.

<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />I must find the Eye of Horus… yes, the Eye is the key… yes, that is the only way…
<g id="g_female_leanbackdrugged" />When he returns, we will suffer his wrath!<g id="g_male_wavehandsnobig" /> He will punish us!<g id="g_male_noway" /> I must intercede! I must save the people!

<g id="g_female_giveitem" />Now that you have the code and the Eye, here is the location of Sutekh’s Necropolis.

<g id="g_female_notsure" />Our people need Cleopatra, now more than ever.

DefaultDialogue: <g id="g_male_spreadhands" />Please help Ghazi to decide how best to serve the people of Brimstone Sands.
This is a great day for Brimstone Sands, and you have made it possible. I am glad the gods led you here.
This is a great day for Brimstone Sands, and you have made it possible. I am glad the gods led you here.

It seems our work is never done. I've received word from a trusted ally named Lysandra.
Keep your senses honed, my friend.
Stay together!<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> There’s strength in numbers!
Stay together!<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> There’s strength in numbers! Ready what weapons you have, but be prepared to run if it comes to that. Don’t lose hope!

<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" bin="1" bout="1.5" />You there! You have a heroic look about you.<g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" bin="1" /> That steely glint in your eyes, the aura of confidence, the distinctive swagger.
I’m not only a scholar, I’m also a chronicler.
<g id="g_male_compliment" />Your bold and effective defense of these refugees has enraged the Legion garrison at Crassus’s Rise.
<g id="g_litearmor_sighrelief" />Luckily, my efforts to locate Imhotep have borne fruit! Aban sent a message that they were heading to Carthago.
<g id="g_litearmor_sighrelief" />Luckily, my efforts to locate Imhotep have borne fruit! Aban sent a message that they were heading to Carthago.
<g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I knew something had gone wrong! I’m cursed with an infallible instinct for these sorts of things.

<g id="g_female_sympathyhandsheart" />Please excuse the mess. Most of the important books and scrolls in the city were seized and stored here.

<g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Words fail me. How can I ever thank you for saving this old goat?
I have a feeling matters are about to get far more complicated.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> And not in a good way. I certainly hope we're both ready.

DefaultDialogue: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />I'll never forget your help in rescuing Imhotep. I’m in your debt.
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />I'll never forget your help in rescuing Imhotep. I’m in your debt.
<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" />Imhotep knows many arcane spells and secrets. His mastery of Ancient magic is<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> unrivaled on Aeternum.
<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" />You may witness all manner of sanity-bending events in Imhotep's presence.
<g id="g_female_clenchfistssuffer" />Oh gods, it’s happened! Just as I feared it would! His state of mind was far more fragile than he had let on. My poor master…
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />We must attend to the words of the Great Pharaoh.<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> I know he seems different, but he's still Imhotep and wise beyond measure.
<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Being named the Great Pharaoh's Sword is an immense honor.<g id="g_female_youknows" /> He seems to have complete confidence in you.
<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />The Great Pharaoh is relying on you. Oh, who am I kidding?<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" /> I'm relying on you.
<g id="g_litearmor_secretiveshort" />The Pools of Orcus are a foul place.<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> The fumes there sicken even the heartiest of individuals.
<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" />This mystery becomes more frightening with every step.
<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />So you intend to enter Akhet? Imhotep built the great pyramid.
<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />The revelation of Sutekh's return has pushed Imhotep's mind to the edge! If we lose him, we are truly doomed!
<g id="g_male_why" />Imhotep’s obsessed with Sutekh’s return! He kept insisting he had to "prepare the way!"
<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" />I don’t know about you, but I could use a hot bath and a nice long nap.<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> Some company would be nice as well…
<g id="g_female_spreadarms" />Bring your beautiful visage here and let me gaze upon you for a few moments!<g id="g_female_headnodding" /> It is so good to see you.
<g id="g_female_nodshrugokay" />I am still pondering your words. There is so much to consider.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> I thought I had escaped the past.
Comments: this no longer grants the quest but reflects convo state after accepting queenrevealed

DefaultDialogue: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />I have considered what you and Imhotep have said. You<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> both sacrificed so much for this land.<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> It is only fair that I do the same.
So, what did the people have to say?
So, what did the people have to say?
What are you doing? Didn’t your Queen command that you relax and enjoy yourself?
Your striking visage is always welcome, Sword of Brimstone. You make the days brighter, and the nights sweeter.
Your striking visage is always welcome, Sword of Brimstone. You make the days brighter, and the nights sweeter.
You look like a person who lives for excitement. Tell me my intuition is right! Life has been ever so dull around here.
Good riddance to that harpy Charmion! I'll be happier without her around.
I've been thinking about writing a new play about you.
Here for the arena? Out of luck. Pontifex shut it down. Nothing to do but sit, wait, and drink.
Heard a lot about you adventurers lately. Sounds like a decent living. See places, meet people, fight monsters.
Arena might open again, with Charmion gone. Don't know if I'll stick around to see it.
Cacti must be god's idea of a joke. They're too bitter to drink, too spiky to eat, and too tough to uproot.
I've brewed a new drink in honor of Queen Cleopatra's return. And you'll never guess what gives it color and flavor.
My goodness, so many new arrivals these days. And your clothes are like nothing I've ever seen!
Poor Evandrus. He's a brave man, coming back to face his demons.
The Queen ordered some purple gowns for her wardrobe. Oh, what am I to do?
No escape. No hope. No salvation from the red-eyed devils. T-they were at Shattered Mountain. On the shores. In the voices that howled.
I n-never was much good with a sword. Father was a rancher. M-maybe I could do the same, somewhere far from the f-fighting.
Let me guess. You saw a poor old woman alone in the desert, and thought she needed help hobbling back to town?
So you've met the Insatiable Flame. That rascal tore up all my plants when he first showed up.
Tamouthis stopped by the other day. Said you put down the scorpion queen and her vile brood. Maybe you're all right for a city-dweller.
The moon and sun were one. Great Kronos peeled back the veil, and I saw the true nature of all things.
The boy does not know, yet he believes himself wise. I have stepped through the gates and lost my way.
You believe yourself victorious. It is but a respite. A moment of calm before the storm.
The locals speak of a mighty wurm that burrows beneath the dunes. This land of blistering sun and biting wind has horrors aplenty, but so far I've seen no sign of the beast.
By God, I was such a fool to come here! A few nights ago, I saw the face of the great wurm.
Finally, someone with the sense to bring their own supplies.
I heard about your exploits at the Great Pyramid. The whole camp talks of nothing else.
You're no soldier. Were we friends, or foes? I… can't recall your face, but I hope you're here to help.
Evandrus. I remember… the day I told him I was retiring. He smiled at me, the happiest smile I've ever seen.
Is it over? I can go back to my farm, and let this fade into the fog of memory.
Devastation and ruin as far as the eye can see, and no one to lead us through it.
I wondered when Charmion would show her true face. Hmph. The less said about her, the better.
Are the rumors true? Has Queen Cleopatra herself returned to us? Part of me yearns to see her splendor.
I've lost two carts, several priceless heirlooms, and my best sandals since leaving New Corsica.
Things seem to be going well, but I think my time in this land is coming to a close. Call it business intuition or wanderlust.
I hope you haven't come in search of healing. I will do my very best, but I have little to work with.
Someday, I'd like to learn how to use a Life Staff. I thought the locals were exaggerating when they told me about it.
Take care of yourself, friend. After all your heroic struggles, I think you've earned a breather.
So many abandoned valuables, so little time. People leave the most incredible things behind.
With the Legion no longer on the rampage, it's easier than ever to scavenge things.
Hah! It seems the New Corsicans finally listened to me, and sent another professional to do their killing.
I hear Evandrus is trying to rehabilitate his father's image. Wonder how much of the eulogizing is true.
If Cleopatra needs mercenaries, put in a word for me. Things got mighty quiet around here.
This desert air is terrible for my tools, to say nothing of my skin. What I wouldn't give for a proper university workshop.
You don't look like a local. I was hoping I might bend your ear for an unusual request.
Sulfur, mercury, gypsum glass, but this fourth element eludes me. Some kind of refined Azoth? How does it remain stable?
W-Who are you?! Stay back, don't come any closer!
Before you appeared, I didn't think strangers would show us any kindness. The gods might have abandoned us, but you didn't.
Oh, mighty Jupiter, have mercy on me!
Naught left but feathers and blood. At this rate I'll be ruined, though we'll all starve first. Now there's a cheery thought.
Naught left but feathers and blood. At this rate I'll be ruined, though we'll all starve first. Now there's a cheery thought.
Naught left but feathers and blood. At this rate I'll be ruined, though we'll all starve first. Now there's a cheery thought.
I'll say this for the New Corsicans. They're a hardy lot. Despite the Legion and the wild beasts, the camp's held together.
What a fine mess. I'll be lucky if I ever find him. Oh, why did that storm have to strike now?
I'm sorry to trouble you, but did you see a man wash up on the southern shore?
I'm sorry to trouble you, but did you see a man wash up on the southern shore?
You'll be glad to hear that no more of the Empress's ships have sailed this way.
These rough conditions are utterly beneath me. Do you know who I am?
They killed me! How dare they! Stabbed me through and tossed me over the palisade like a rag doll! Oh, the indignity of it all…
Oh. I began working on a new book, about textiles and evolving fashion among the Roman exiles.
Will she ever forgive me? Her Excellency isn't known for her charitable nature, but this humble servant can hope for her favor.
(The armadillo gives you a single, disdainful sniff before looking away.)
We have strayed from the ways of our ancestors. And in return, the curse of the Lost is ours to bear.
Memory fades with each passing year, and none remember the old rituals.
What incantation do I try next? To whom do I pray? Someone must hear our prayers. If not… no, I dare not entertain the thought.
Hrrm? A delicious passing morsel? No, you look rather too large and uncomfortable to eat.
A human? Ah, my favorite human, the bringer of fish. May your sunbeams be warm, your catches plentiful, and your belly full.
According to this map, the ruin's a bit further up the cliff. Oh, I should've asked for directions before wandering out here.
Ah, a fellow traveler! This may strike you as an odd question, but have you ever seen a dragon on this mountainside?
Thanks to you, I'm overflowing with ideas for my sculptures. Why stop at dragon eggs?
I can't help watching the Great Pyramid out of the corner of my eye. Do you know what holds it aloft? Neither do I. I don't like the thought one bit.
Another mercenary. The deserts have been lousy with you lot. Pick up a survey map and make yourself useful. How's your hearing?
The tremors continue, but I've yet to see the creature emerge above ground.
I've had it with my family! My mother, my uncles, the whole decrepit lot of them.
You're also new to this place, aren't you?
Please don't disturb an old man's peaceful retirement.I believe I've earned some quiet.
The Ancients must have been giants compared to us.
I'll have a limp for weeks. Monsieur Heron makes scrambling up and down ancient ruins sound so easy!
Have you seen the circular stone gates at Hermopolis? There is one just like them, right above our heads.
Do you think Monsieur Heron would be interested in collaborating with me?
Mind your step, traveler. The little scorpions are easy to skewer, but the big ones get the better of many overconfident hunters.
I've heard the most fantastic rumors about you. So, you should have no trouble with a large swarm of angry scorpions.
The creatures of the wilds are not to be feared, but understood. That lesson's lost on most, but not you. It's nice to meet a kindred spirit.
Those pillars look much taller up close.
Phew, finally got away from all those guardians.
A fellow Soulwarden out here? Well, I won't look a gift horse in the mouth.
I thought the ruins in Everfall were impressive, but that was before I laid eyes on the Wall.
You are far from civilization, stranger. Indulge me in an odd question: how adept are you at handling great beasts of the desert?
You again? The sacrifice has been accepted, and we can only pray that the gods stay their wrath. Go, now. I have no more coin or treasure for you.
(The jackal's piercing eyes look you over from head to toe.)
Jabir ibn Hayyan posits a balance of sulfur and mercury, but the potency of local sulfur overwhelms mercury and disrupts the normal methods of transmutation.
All these excavations, and for what? For all our efforts at enlightenment, we seem to reap nothing but dust.
New Corsica, ancient bastion of knowledge and hidden secrets. I find this place suits me, though I wish travel by spirit shrines wasn't so nauseating.
How goes your search for the Ancient glyphs?
Your dedication to knowledge may even come close to my own. And you're much better suited to exploring dangerous locales.
This bag was almost buried by the sands. It contains several small portraits on wood, a half-full waterskin, and a brittle note.
This small, weathered statue appears unremarkable.
It's hard to make out the writing on this ancient tablet. You can only pick out three words: Ennead, pilgrimage, power.
Please… help me… aahhh… please…
Please… help me… aahhh… please…
Hearken to the words of the blessed Pontifex Charmion! She speaks for the gods and dispenses their wisdom!
New Corsica welcomes you, pilgrim.
Prayer alone will not save us! The gods require deeds! Words without action are empty!
The people of New Corsica need a better way forward. Not a new faith, but a fresh interpretation for changing times.
Attend the words of the Pontifex Nuru. Her wisdom will guide us into a new age of enlightenment.
Comments: Dejected after not being named Pontifex

DefaultDialogue: You would be an excellent candidate for the Marauders. If you wish to join our battles, I welcome you with open arms.
We never run out of foes to fight and victories to win. This vicious island suits us Marauders.
You'll want Adjudicator Teos, not me. I never was much of an orator.
Talk to Alchemist Euphrosyne if you must. I never have any idea what you Syndicate are talking about.
There are no pretenses among us Marauders. You're here for gold, battle, and glory, and I have opportunites aplenty.
Others see eternal life as a curse, but not the seekers of the Syndicate.
Welcome, welcome. There are enough mysteries in this land to keep both of us occupied.
We're not so different, you and I. All you need is a little more curiosity about the light you so fervently safeguard.
Don't you ever wonder if there's more to life than battle and bloodshed? If so, you know where to find me.
Someday, we'll rival the works of the Ancients themselves. We will be the architects of our own paradise, right here on Aeternum.
Are you lost, friend? We all are, in one way or another.
We sing the song of hope on an island of strife.
A Marauder? If you're here to pick a fight, I must decline. This is not the time or place.
For those who claim to know so much, you Syndicate understand little. Farewell.
